title: Neuromodulation is like a Car Wash -- It Works!
subtitle: A brief reflection on automation by our author
body_html:
It is not news to readers of this newsletter that Owen Muir, M.D. loves Neuromodulation—changing your brain with direct brain stimulation—as an approach. He went on a drive to films some video content and Angela Cappetta, award winning photographer, came with him to shoot.

We talked on the way about why Neuromodulation is a useful way to address brain disorders. Some of that chatting happened in a car wash.

Here is a clip. Enjoy!

More video content is available on the Videos Link on the top of the website, please share freely!
